text: {"features":[{"name":"Role understanding","description":"Assesses how clearly the letter understands this team's mission of scaling security work through tooling, automation, AI agents, and developer support.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as generic to many software jobs and shows little understanding of this team's specific work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows broad awareness of security or automation but only loosely connects that awareness to this team's mandate."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly recognizes that the role is about building software to automate or embed security work into engineering practice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Connects several specific aspects of the role, such as foundational leverage, developer support, vulnerability handling, or AI agents."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows nuanced understanding of how this team scales security across Google through tooling, triage, lifecycle integration, variant analysis, and intelligent automation."}]},{"name":"Role motivation","description":"Assesses how compellingly the letter explains why this specific security-engineering role is the applicant's desired next step.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"States interest in the role with little personal rationale or sense of direction."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses general enthusiasm for security or Google but does not show why this particular role is the right fit."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a clear reason for applying that connects the role to prior work or a preferred kind of impact."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Conveys strong intrinsic motivation for foundational security tooling work, with a memorable and role-relevant rationale."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Builds a compelling career narrative that makes this role feel like a natural and highly intentional next step."}]},{"name":"Academic preparation","description":"Assesses how strongly the letter's stated formal education aligns with the role's preference for advanced technical study.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"States a bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field and nothing beyond the minimum academic bar."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States a bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field and frames it as a strong technical foundation, but without graduate study."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States a master's degree in computer science or a related technical field."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"States a doctoral degree in computer science or a related technical field."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Uses advanced graduate study to reinforce exceptional technical rigor or research depth relevant to complex security tooling work."}]},{"name":"Software engineering experience","description":"Assesses the depth and relevance of the applicant's professional experience testing, maintaining, and launching production software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only the minimum professional background, with limited breadth of services or lifecycle ownership."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows a few years of relevant experience but only modest production breadth or weak evidence of end-to-end ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid mid-level experience across multiple production services and lifecycle stages."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong experience with repeated launch, maintenance, and testing responsibility across several production services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows extensive relevant production experience for this role level, with sustained multi-service ownership and clear breadth across the software lifecycle."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"Assesses the extent to which the letter establishes strong professional experience in Go, the required language for the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only briefly as one language among several, with no sense that it is central to recent work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Indicates professional use of Go but gives little evidence of depth or primary reliance."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular production use of Go as an important working language."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents Go as the primary, daily, or principal language for backend or infrastructure work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows deep, role-relevant Go experience by tying it directly to backend systems, security tooling, or agent-control infrastructure."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"Assesses the extent to which the letter establishes practical professional use of Python in tooling, services, or automation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of Python experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python only briefly or ambiguously, without showing real professional use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows working Python experience for tooling, scripts, prototypes, or services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes substantial Python use in production automation, analysis, or service development."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Python as a major professional language with concrete production use in automation, analysis, agents, or internal services."}]},{"name":"AI systems experience","description":"Assesses the depth of hands-on experience building or operating AI-backed functionality relevant to production environments.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of AI or machine-learning work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest or light exposure without clear production responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes direct hands-on work on AI-backed features or workflows."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows production experience with AI systems plus awareness of evaluation, reliability, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents substantial hands-on AI delivery experience with concrete evidence of operating model-backed systems responsibly in production."}]},{"name":"Agentic tooling design","description":"Assesses the extent to which the letter shows experience designing autonomous or agent-based systems with appropriate controls.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of designing agentic systems or autonomous tooling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or automation loosely without showing architecture or design responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows some experience building multi-step autonomous tooling or agent workflows."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly describes an agent architecture with Python agents and separate services or mechanisms that constrain behavior."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents mature agent-system design thinking, including bounded autonomy, permissions, logging, supervision, auditing, or other explicit control mechanisms."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"Assesses the depth of experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or related security workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of vulnerability triage or report-handling automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Alludes to security automation broadly without describing intake, queue, or triage workflows."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions automating some part of vulnerability intake, routing, or queue handling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives a clear example of classifying, deduplicating, routing, or prioritizing vulnerability reports."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong end-to-end ownership of vulnerability-handling automation as a force multiplier that materially reduced manual security workload."}]},{"name":"Security assessment experience","description":"Assesses the depth and rigor of hands-on experience performing security reviews, threat modeling, or validating fixes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of performing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security awareness or interest but not actual assessment work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes some hands-on review activity such as threat modeling, code review, or validation of fixes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows structured assessment experience across designs or services, including attack-surface mapping or remediation follow-through."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial assessment maturity by framing security reviews as systematic engineering work with clear methods, attacker thinking, and follow-through."}]},{"name":"Data structures depth","description":"Assesses how strongly the letter demonstrates practical fluency with data structures and algorithms.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of data-structures or algorithmic skill."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Makes a generic claim about algorithms or technical rigor without a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives one concrete example of algorithmic or data-structure use."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong practical fluency with examples of redesigning systems, indexes, traversals, schedulers, or matching logic."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents algorithmic thinking as a clear strength, with concrete examples showing meaningful system simplification, scalability gains, or performance improvement."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"Assesses how concretely the letter supports its claims with observable examples, technologies, and outcomes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Makes mostly high-level claims with little concrete evidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Names relevant skills or domains but gives limited detail about what was actually built or improved."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides several concrete examples, though some important claims remain general."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Consistently supports claims with specific systems, responsibilities, or outcomes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Uses repeated, precise examples that make the applicant's fit highly credible by linking problem, action, technology, and result."}]},{"name":"Open-source contribution","description":"Assesses the depth of contribution to external software projects, especially through patches, maintenance, or releases.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of open-source contribution."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional patching or contribution in passing."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes recurring upstream fixes or modest ongoing contribution."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows meaningful ownership such as maintaining a library or regularly contributing and reviewing changes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial open-source leadership, such as maintaining a project or framework with clear responsibility for reviews, releases, and direction."}]},{"name":"Supplementary security engagement","description":"Assesses the strength of security commitment shown through certifications, competitions, or other extra-professional security practice.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no meaningful evidence of security practice beyond normal job duties."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes only a light extra signal, such as casual participation or a basic credential mentioned briefly."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows one solid extra signal, such as recurring CTF participation or a foundational security certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows a strong extra signal, such as OSCP-level rigor, serious competitive practice, or repeatedly strong results."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates exceptional outside security commitment through especially rigorous credentials, elite competition results, or multiple strong signals."}]},{"name":"Personal technical initiative","description":"Assesses the degree of self-directed engineering shown through side projects or other independent technical builds.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of self-directed technical work outside assigned job duties."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small personal project or tinkering effort with limited technical challenge."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows ongoing self-directed building that indicates curiosity and continued learning."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a nontrivial independent project with meaningful systems or reliability complexity."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents an ambitious self-driven build that tackles hard engineering problems such as replication, failover, consensus, compaction, or recovery."}]},{"name":"Writing polish","description":"Assesses the clarity, professionalism, and mechanical correctness of the letter's writing.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent mechanical errors or awkward phrasing that noticeably distract from the application."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has persistent errors and rough spots, though the meaning remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Is generally clear and professional but includes several noticeable mistakes or clunky sentences."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Reads smoothly with good structure and only minor distracting errors."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is polished, concise, and easy to read, with strong flow and negligible mechanical issues."}]}]}
